name: REMOVED_PROTOCOLS
description: This table links Cell Therapy treatment plans to protocols that were removed from the plan.

columns.name: TREATMENT_PLAN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the plan record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: REMOVE_PROTOCOL_ID
columns.description: Stores protocols removed from the plan.

columns.name: REMOVE_PROTOCOL_ID_PROTOCOL_NAME
columns.description: The SmartSet/Protocol record name.  This is different from the display name, which is stored in CL_PRL_SS_OT.DISPLAY_NAME.

columns.name: REMOVED_REASON
columns.description: The reason the associated protocol was removed from the plan.
